title: CTGAN
summary: A fork of the sdv-dev CTGAN library that vendors the ctgan/ source tree and adds an experimental differential-privacy option (`dp=`) to the CTGANSynthesizer, demonstrated on the UCI Adult Census dataset. It vendors and modifies SDV's CTGAN synthesizer in-tree, extending it with a differential-privacy training mode.
evidence: Untitled.ipynb:682 `ctgan2 = CTGANSynthesizer(verbose=True, dp=False, epochs=300)`; ctgan/ is a full vendored copy of sdv-dev/CTGAN
needs: README is copied verbatim from sdv-dev/CTGAN and the citation block credits the original CTGAN paper authors, not necessarily this fork's author; the extent of the dp-related code modification beyond the notebook's dp=False call could not be verified from the given evidence.
